about_the_game:
DVD Store Simulator is a fun simulation game where you get to build and manage your very own DVD store! In this free demo, you'll sell popular DVDs, figures, and tech products to earn money and start building the shop of your dreams.

This demo offers a taste of the full DVD Store Simulator experience, featuring core gameplay mechanics.

What You'll Experience in the Demo:

  • 🏬 STORE MANAGEMENT - Improve the customer experience! Organize shelves, display products, and make your shop a place where customers can easily find what they're looking for.

  • 🛒 ORDER PRODUCT – Manage your stock of DVDs, figures, and tech products. Follow trends, order popular items, and fulfill customer requests.

  • 🧹 CLEANING SYSTEM – Customers can make a mess! Keep your shop clean and tidy to maintain a welcoming environment. A dirty store might drive people away.

  • 🏗️ LIMITED GROWTH OPTIONS – You'll get a chance to expand your shop space, add new shelves, and display cases. However, the full range of growth and renovation options is reserved for the complete game.

Full Game Features Not Fully Available or Absent in the Demo:

The full version of DVD Store Simulator offers a much richer and deeper experience. Here's what you'll find limited or absent in this demo compared to the full game:

  • Expanded Product Range: While the demo includes a limited selection of DVDs, figures, and tech products, the full game will feature a much wider variety and more categories to choose from.

  • Comprehensive Store Expansion: Beyond the basic growth in the demo, the full version allows for extensive redesign of your store's size and layout with many more expansion options and "DIY" store items.

  • Extended License System: You'll only be able to acquire the first 3 licenses in the demo. The full game will grant access to many more licenses, enabling you to offer an even broader product range.

  • DVD Collection System: The full game will include a dedicated DVD collection system that you can build and manage.

  • Deeper Customer Interactions: While the demo features basic customer traffic, the full game will allow for deeper interactions with your customers.

  • Pirated DVD Crafting: The full game will introduce a pirated DVD crafting mechanic, allowing you to experiment with different strategies.

  • Online Order System: In the full game, you'll be able to receive online orders for your store, expanding your customer base.

short_description: Run a vintage DVD shop in this charming simulation demo! Sell DVDs, figures, and tech products. Organise your store, keep it clean, and satisfy your customers. Follow trends, manage stock, and expand your collection. Feel the nostalgic joy of running your own retro store!
